integrity: Symbolic path contraction and forced-cycle counts supply the all-size proof; independently enumerated full permutations n<=8 and exact integer identities through n=120; finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations and fixed consecutive triple patterns only; first covariance moments, not a joint law. Historical priority remains provisional due to inaccessible full text of a relevant 1993 paper.
title: A rank-two positional dependence law for permutation cycles and consecutive triples
